camera: cam02 at the intersection 33.950158,-83.377213. The camera sits on the SE corner, the Tate parking deck entrance corner, looking NW across S Lumpkin St. In frame that puts north to the upper right, west to the upper left, east to the right, south to the lower left.
note: Semantics supplied by the user (2026-08-17), checked against the Google map of the intersection. All 18 zones are user-confirmed. Landmark naming, matching the Lumpkin_at_Baxter convention: legion = Legion Lot side, tate = Tate parking deck side, bolton = Bolton side. Legion Lot counts as a formal arm, so this is a four-arm intersection: each of the four arms has exactly one crosswalk across it, and Zone_05 is the junction box every turn passes through.

Zone_17.name: road_lumpkin_south_arm
Zone_17.note: The south arm itself leaves frame almost at once, so the original polygon was a 1.8% sliver, too small to call. On the user's suggestion (2026-08-17) it was redrawn onto the Zone_02 crosswalk footprint: every vehicle entering or leaving the south arm has to cross the crosswalk, so it works as a gate rather than an area. Now 9.9% of the framed area, a 6x gain in samples per vehicle, and it overlaps no other vehicle zone. Zone_02 is unchanged and still counts pedestrians over the same ground; vehicles and pedestrians are ledgered separately so the shared footprint is safe.
